datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mauritania in 2016. The spatial classifications were compiled into geographic datasets representing different IPC scenarios for February, June, and October 2016, providing temporal snapshots of acute food insecurity impact across administrative regions.
